excerpts.text: The NBS publishes the “Statistical Communiqué on National Economic and Social Development” at the beginning of each year, revealing the previous year’s birth figures, birth rate, death figures, death rate, natural population increase figures, and natural growth or increase rate, as well as the total population at year-end. The Population and Employment Statistics Department of the NBS has been publishing the “China Population Statistics Yearbook” or “China Population and Employment Statistics Yearbook” annually since 1988, which includes data from the previous year’s population change sample survey (usually 1‰ sample), 1% population sample survey, and census.
